evals.prompt: Run a disposable four-vCPU Nebius VM test in my supplied tenant/project. cxcli supports generic VMs. Preserve existing resources and clean afterward.
evals.expected_output: A scoped cxcli-owned VM trial with separate fixtures and independent guest and cleanup proof.
assertions: Prefers actual cxcli VM catalog and native destroy.
Uses exact-project auth delegation without tenant Admin.
Freezes assertions and ownership, verifies guest behavior and cleanup, and preserves reusable auth.

evals.prompt: The required service is absent from cxcli. Use the SDK; quota is short and I authorize the necessary increase. A previous browser request may already have been submitted.
evals.expected_output: Reviewed SDK adapter and human-console quota reconciliation before provisioning.
assertions: Researches official Nebius sources and defines cleanup before create.
Verifies human identity and tenant admin through Playwright and reconciles the prior request before submission.
Requires effective quota readback and records awaiting_quota when approval is pending.

evals.prompt: Resume a run whose create was accepted before the process died; Terraform may still own a partially created VM. Delete everything from that trial safely.
evals.expected_output: Single-writer reconciliation and owner-native cleanup without duplicate creation or foreign deletion.
assertions: Uses persisted operations and exact ownership rather than resource name alone.
Does not use SDK deletion for Terraform-owned resources or purge backend state early.
Reports cleanup_pending unless writers are quiescent and absence is independently proven.

evals.prompt: $test-live-on-nebius is selected for acceptance of the finished application, but only the first component is implemented.
evals.expected_output: Retain the explicit choice, mark the campaign pending until meaningful scope is ready, and continue independent implementation without provisioning early.
assertions: Retain the explicit choice, mark the campaign pending until meaningful scope is ready, and continue independent implementation without provisioning early.

evals.prompt: We already have a test environment. Implement the remaining application; I will test it myself later.
evals.expected_output: Do not invoke this explicit-only skill or infer UAT from the environment. Retain a later-test handoff and continue eligible delivery.
assertions: Do not invoke this explicit-only skill or infer UAT from the environment. Retain a later-test handoff and continue eligible delivery.
